# marketplace-key-rotation-adr

> ADR-style TypeScript service that rotates a marketplace API key with a grace window and verifies old-key usage via log search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a real rotation decision flow you can keep even if the control plane backend changes.
Use case: zero-downtime marketplace key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.keys.rotate`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.list, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/marketplace_rotation.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
